es2-japanese.label: Grade 2
es2-japanese.title: Elementary Japanese, Grade 2
es2-japanese.scope: 160 Grade 2 kanji, words written in katakana, subjects and predicates, polite language, speaking and writing in a logical order, scenes and characters in stories, order in explanatory texts

es2-math.label: Grade 2
es2-math.title: Elementary Math, Grade 2
es2-math.scope: Numbers up to 1000 and 10,000, written addition and subtraction, multiplication tables, length (cm, mm, m), volume (L, dL, mL), time of day and duration, triangles and quadrilaterals, box shapes, simple fractions, tables and graphs

es3-japanese.label: Grade 3
es3-japanese.title: Elementary Japanese, Grade 3
es3-japanese.scope: 200 Grade 3 kanji, Romaji, how to use a Japanese dictionary, modifiers, demonstrative words (ko-so-a-do words), paragraphs and main points, changes in characters' feelings in stories, proverbs and idioms, haiku

es3-math.label: Grade 3
es3-math.title: Elementary Math, Grade 3
es3-math.scope: Numbers up to 100 million, written multiplication, division and division with remainders, decimals, fractions, length (km) and weight (g, kg), time of day and duration, circles and spheres, isosceles and equilateral triangles, expressions using □, bar graphs and tables

es3-science.label: Grade 3
es3-science.title: Elementary Science, Grade 3
es3-science.scope: Living things around us (how plants grow, insect bodies and growth), the sun and the ground, properties of light, properties of sound, wind and the force of rubber, properties of magnets, paths of electricity, objects and weight

es3-social.label: Grade 3
es3-social.title: Elementary Social Studies, Grade 3
es3-social.scope: The local area and our city, ward, town, or village, map symbols and directions, local production and sales work, protecting our lives from fires and accidents, changes in the city over time

es4-japanese.label: Grade 4
es4-japanese.title: Elementary Japanese, Grade 4
es4-japanese.scope: 202 Grade 4 kanji (including prefecture kanji), how to use a kanji dictionary, connecting words, relationships between paragraphs, summarizing, characters' personalities and scenery in stories, tanka and haiku, idioms from classical Chinese stories

es4-math.label: Grade 4
es4-math.title: Elementary Math, Grade 4
es4-math.scope: Large numbers (hundred millions and trillions), approximate numbers, written division, addition and subtraction of decimals and decimals × ÷ whole numbers, addition and subtraction of fractions, angles, perpendicular and parallel lines and quadrilaterals, area, rectangular prisms and cubes, expressions and order of operations, how quantities change, line graphs

es4-science.label: Grade 4
es4-science.title: Elementary Science, Grade 4
es4-science.scope: Seasons and living things, weather and temperature, the moon and stars, where rainwater goes and the ground, the human body and movement (bones and muscles), properties of air and water, metals, water, air, and temperature, effects of electric current

es4-social.label: Grade 4
es4-social.title: Elementary Social Studies, Grade 4
es4-social.scope: Features of the prefectures (names and locations of the 47 prefectures), water, electricity, waste and our lives, activities to protect people from natural disasters, traditions and culture in the prefecture and the work of people of the past, distinctive regions

es5-japanese.label: Grade 5
es5-japanese.title: Elementary Japanese, Grade 5
es5-japanese.scope: 193 Grade 5 kanji, honorific language, native Japanese, Sino-Japanese, and loanwords, dialects and standard Japanese, main ideas, characters and the effects of expression in stories, opinion writing, becoming familiar with classical Japanese and Chinese texts

es5-math.label: Grade 5
es5-math.title: Elementary Math, Grade 5
es5-math.scope: Whole numbers and decimals, multiplication and division of decimals, multiples and divisors, addition and subtraction of fractions (common denominators and reducing), averages, quantity per unit, speed, ratios and percentages, congruent figures, angles of figures, regular polygons and circumference, area (triangles, parallelograms, trapezoids, rhombuses), volume, prisms and cylinders, band graphs and pie charts, proportion

hs-matha.label: Mathematics A
hs-matha.title: High School: Mathematics A
hs-matha.scope: Number of Cases and Probability (permutations and combinations, probability, conditional probability, expected value); Properties of Figures (properties of triangles, properties of circles, constructions, solid figures); Mathematics and Human Activities (properties of integers, Euclidean algorithm, base-n numbers)

hs-math2.label: Mathematics II
hs-math2.title: High School: Mathematics II
hs-math2.scope: Expressions and Proofs (binomial theorem, division of polynomials, proving equations and inequalities); Complex Numbers and Equations (complex numbers, relations between roots and coefficients, factor theorem, higher-degree equations); Figures and Equations (points and lines, circles, loci and regions); Trigonometric Functions (radian measure, addition formulas); Exponential and Logarithmic Functions; Differentiation and Integration

hs-mathb.label: Mathematics B
hs-mathb.title: High School: Mathematics B
hs-mathb.scope: Sequences (arithmetic and geometric sequences, summation notation, recurrence relations, mathematical induction); Statistical Inference (random variables and probability distributions, binomial distribution, normal distribution, population and sample, estimation, hypothesis testing); Mathematics and Social Life

hs-math3.label: Mathematics III
hs-math3.title: High School: Mathematics III
hs-math3.scope: Limits (limits of sequences, infinite series, limits of functions); Differentiation (derivatives, derivatives of various functions, tangent lines, increase/decrease of functions and graphs, velocity and approximation); Integration (indefinite integrals, integration by substitution and by parts, definite integrals, area, volume, and arc length)

hs-mathc.label: Mathematics C
hs-mathc.title: High School: Mathematics C
hs-mathc.scope: Vectors (plane vectors, space vectors, dot product, applications to figures); Plane Curves and the Complex Plane (conic sections, parametric representation, polar coordinates, complex plane, de Moivre's theorem); Devising Mathematical Expressions

hs-gendai-kokugo.label: Contemporary Japanese
hs-gendai-kokugo.title: High School Japanese: Contemporary Japanese
hs-gendai-kokugo.scope: Language skills needed in the real world. Reading logical texts (claims and evidence, development of logic), summarizing, writing opinion pieces, reports, and proposals, discussion and presentation, handling information, vocabulary and kanji

hs-gengo-bunka.label: Language Culture
hs-gengo-bunka.title: High School Japanese: Language Culture
hs-gengo-bunka.scope: Introduction to Classical Japanese (historical kana usage, conjugation of inflected words, basics of auxiliary verbs, anecdotes, essays, tales, waka poetry); Introduction to Classical Chinese (kundoku reading, kaeriten marks, words read twice, historical anecdotes, Chinese poetry, the Analects); Modern and contemporary literary texts (novels, poetry, tanka and haiku); changes in language and culture

hs-ronri-kokugo.label: Logical Japanese
hs-ronri-kokugo.title: High School Japanese: Logical Japanese
hs-ronri-kokugo.scope: Reading critical essays (abstract and concrete, contrast, cause and effect, examining the author's claims); texts on modern and contemporary thought and society; comparing multiple texts; patterns of argumentation; writing short essays (structure, evidence, responding to counterarguments)

hs-bungaku-kokugo.label: Literary Japanese
hs-bungaku-kokugo.title: High School Japanese: Literary Japanese
hs-bungaku-kokugo.scope: Reading novels (characters, narration, historical background, themes); appreciating poetry; essays; literary history (modern to contemporary); stating interpretations with supporting evidence; creative writing

hs-koten-tankyu.label: Classics Exploration
hs-koten-tankyu.title: High School Japanese: Classics Exploration
hs-koten-tankyu.scope: Classical Japanese (completing grammar: auxiliary verbs, particles, honorifics, distinguishing similar forms, rhetorical devices in waka, reading The Tale of Genji, The Pillow Book, Ōkagami, Tsurezuregusa, etc., literary history); Classical Chinese (sentence patterns: causative, passive, negation, question, rhetorical question, comparison, emphasis by contrast; reading historical writings, philosophy, and Chinese poetry); connections between the classics and the present

hs-eicom1.label: English Communication I
hs-eicom1.title: High School English: English Communication I
hs-eicom1.scope: Review and extension of junior high grammar (tenses, auxiliary verbs, passive voice, infinitives, gerunds, participles, relatives, comparison); reading English texts on familiar and social topics; listening, speaking, and writing activities; vocabulary

hs-eicom2.label: English Communication II
hs-eicom2.title: High School English: English Communication II
hs-eicom2.scope: Advanced grammar (advanced perfect tenses, subjunctive mood, participial constructions, relative adverbs, compound relatives, narration, emphasis and inversion); reading strategies for expository, argumentative, and narrative texts; summarizing; expressing opinions

jhs1-math.label: Year 1
jhs1-math.title: Junior High Math, Year 1
jhs1-math.scope: Positive and negative numbers, Letters and expressions, Linear equations, Proportion and inverse proportion, Plane figures, Solid figures, Using data

jhs1-japanese.label: Year 1
jhs1-japanese.title: Junior High Japanese, Year 1
jhs1-japanese.scope: Speaking and listening, Writing (explanations and opinions), How to read expository and literary texts, Units of language, bunsetsu, and sentence components, Word classes (parts of speech), Kanji, Poetry, Introduction to classical literature (historical kana usage, idioms from classical stories, The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter), Reading classical Chinese (kundoku)

jhs1-science.label: Year 1
jhs1-science.title: Junior High Science, Year 1
jhs1-science.scope: Substances around us (density, gases, aqueous solutions, changes of state), Light and sound, Effects of force, Diverse living things and their common features (classifying plants and animals), Formation and changes of the Earth (volcanoes, earthquakes, strata)

jhs1-english.label: Year 1
jhs1-english.title: Junior High English, Year 1
jhs1-english.scope: Be-verbs, Regular verbs, Question words, Imperatives, Can, Plural forms, Pronouns, Third-person singular present, Present progressive, Past tense (regular verbs and be-verbs), Introduction to expressing the future, Basic reading, writing, and speaking

jhs-geography.label: Geography
jhs-geography.title: Junior High Social Studies (Geography)
jhs-geography.scope: The world's features (continents and oceans, latitude and longitude, time differences), Japan's features (territory, prefectures), People's lives and environments around the world, World regions (Asia, Europe, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania), Methods of regional research, Regional characteristics of Japan (nature, population, resources and energy, industry, transportation and communication), Regions of Japan (Kyushu to Hokkaido), The future of regions

jhs-history.label: History
jhs-history.title: Junior High Social Studies (History)
jhs-history.scope: Ways of understanding history (dates, periodization), Japan up to ancient times (rise of civilizations, Jomon, Yayoi, Kofun, Asuka, Nara, Heian), Medieval period (Kamakura, Muromachi), Early modern period (arrival of Europeans, Oda and Toyotomi regimes, Edo shogunate), Modern period (development of the West, opening of Japan and Meiji Restoration, Sino-Japanese and Russo-Japanese Wars, World War I, Taisho Democracy, Great Depression and World War II), Contemporary period (postwar reforms, Cold War, high economic growth, contemporary Japan and the world)

jhs2-math.label: Year 2
jhs2-math.title: Junior High Math, Year 2
jhs2-math.scope: Calculating expressions (monomials and polynomials, using algebraic expressions), Simultaneous equations, Linear functions, Investigating figures (parallel lines and angles, angles of polygons, congruence and proofs), Properties of figures and proofs (isosceles triangles, right triangles, parallelograms), Probability, Distribution of data (interquartile range and box plots)

jhs2-japanese.label: Year 2
jhs2-japanese.title: Junior High Japanese, Year 2
jhs2-japanese.scope: Conjugation of inflected words, Particles and auxiliary verbs, Honorifics (keigo), Synonyms, antonyms, and polysemous words, Reading to follow the development of an argument, Expression in literary texts, Tanka and poetry, Opinion essays, Classical literature (The Pillow Book, The Tale of the Heike, Essays in Idleness, Chinese poetry)

jhs2-science.label: Year 2
jhs2-science.title: Junior High Science, Year 2
jhs2-science.scope: Chemical changes, atoms, and molecules (chemical formulas, chemical equations, oxidation and reduction, conservation of mass), Electric current and its uses (circuits, Ohm's law, electric power, current and magnetic fields, electromagnetic induction), Structure and functions of living bodies (cells, photosynthesis and transpiration, digestion, respiration, and circulation, stimulus and response), Weather and its changes (atmospheric pressure, cloud formation, fronts, weather in Japan)

jhs2-english.label: Year 2
jhs2-english.title: Junior High English, Year 2
jhs2-english.scope: Future expressions (be going to, will), Auxiliary verbs (must, have to, should, may), Infinitives, Gerunds, Conjunctions (when, if, because, that), Comparison, There is/are constructions, Passive voice, Sentence patterns (SVOO, SVOC), Reading comprehension and expression

jhs-civics.label: Civics
jhs-civics.title: Junior High Social Studies (Civics)
jhs-civics.scope: Modern society and us (informatization, globalization, declining birthrate and aging population, culture, efficiency and fairness), Respect for human dignity and the Constitution of Japan (fundamental human rights, pacifism), Democratic politics (elections, the Diet, the Cabinet, and the courts, local self-government), Economy (consumer life, market economy and prices, businesses, finance, public finance and social security, labor), International society (sovereign states, the United Nations, global environment, resources and energy, and poverty, a sustainable society)

jhs3-math.label: Year 3
jhs3-math.title: Junior High Math, Year 3
jhs3-math.scope: Expanding and factoring expressions, Square roots, Quadratic equations, The function y=ax², Figures and similarity, Inscribed angles and central angles, The Pythagorean theorem, Sampling surveys

es5-science.label: Grade 5
es5-science.title: Elementary Science, Grade 5
es5-science.scope: Germination, growth, and fruiting of plants; animal birth (killifish, humans); the work of flowing water and changes in land; changes in weather; how things dissolve; pendulum motion; magnetic force produced by electric current

es5-social.label: Grade 5
es5-social.title: Elementary Social Studies, Grade 5
es5-social.scope: Japan's land and its position in the world; topography, climate, and daily life; food production (agriculture, fisheries); industrial production, trade, and transportation; information and industry; natural disasters, forests, pollution, and the environment

es5-english.label: Grade 5
es5-english.title: Elementary English, Grade 5
es5-english.scope: The alphabet; self-introduction; birthdays and dates; things one can do (can); locations and giving directions; ordering and prices; people I admire; class schedules and school subjects

es6-japanese.label: Grade 6
es6-japanese.title: Elementary Japanese, Grade 6
es6-japanese.scope: The 191 kanji for Grade 6; how compound words are formed; changes in language; structure and development of texts; claims and supporting evidence; themes of stories; classical literature (kyogen, Chinese poetry, etc.); expressive techniques

es6-math.label: Grade 6
es6-math.title: Elementary Math, Grade 6
es6-math.scope: Letters and expressions; multiplication and division of fractions; ratios; proportion and inverse proportion; symmetrical figures; enlarged and reduced figures; area of circles; volume of prisms and cylinders; approximate shapes and sizes; arrangements and combinations; data analysis (representative values, dot plots, histograms)

es6-science.label: Grade 6
es6-science.title: Elementary Science, Grade 6
es6-science.scope: How combustion works; structure and functions of the human body; plant nutrients and the path of water; living things and the environment; the Moon and Sun; structure and changes of the land; properties of aqueous solutions; principles of levers; uses of electricity

es6-social.label: Grade 6
es6-social.title: Elementary Social Studies, Grade 6
es6-social.scope: The Constitution of Japan and the functions of government (Diet, Cabinet, courts); Japanese history (from the Jomon period to the present, focusing on historical figures and cultural properties); Japan in the world (countries with close ties, the United Nations and international cooperation)

es6-english.label: Grade 6
es6-english.title: Elementary English, Grade 6
es6-english.scope: Self-introduction and things I like; introducing Japan; summer vacation memories (past tense); countries I want to visit; introducing my town; elementary school memories; dreams for the future; junior high school life

es12-seikatsu.label: Grades 1–2
es12-seikatsu.title: Elementary Life Studies, Grades 1–2
es12-seikatsu.scope: School and daily life (school exploration, safety on the way to school); home and daily life (household chores, things I can do by myself); community and daily life (town exploration, people in the community); using public property and facilities; seasonal changes and daily life (seasonal events, nearby nature); play using nature and objects; raising animals and growing plants (growing morning glories and cherry tomatoes, caring for living things); sharing about daily life and events; my growth (things I can now do, myself from now on)

es12-ongaku.label: Grades 1–2
es12-ongaku.title: Elementary Music, Grades 1–2
es12-ongaku.scope: Singing (how to sing, singing with solfège names; common songs: Umi, Katatsumuri, Hinomaru, Hiraita Hiraita, Kakurenbo, Haru ga Kita, Mushi no Koe, Yuyake Koyake); instrumental music (melodica, percussion instruments); music making (sound play); appreciation (listening while imagining the scene); elements that form music (timbre, rhythm, tempo, melody, dynamics, beat, repetition, call and response); basics of notes, rests, and symbols

es34-ongaku.label: Grades 3–4
es34-ongaku.title: Elementary Music, Grades 3–4
es34-ongaku.scope: Singing (common songs: Usagi, Chatsumi, Haru no Ogawa, Fujisan, Sakura Sakura, Tonbi, Makiba no Asa, Momiji); instrumental music (recorder, keyboard instruments, percussion instruments); music making; appreciation (timbres of instruments, Japanese music, music of the world); elements that form music (layering of sounds, scales, phrases, variation); reading music in treble clef; solfège names in C major

es56-ongaku.label: Grades 5–6
es56-ongaku.title: Elementary Music, Grades 5–6
es56-ongaku.scope: Singing (common songs: Koinobori, Komoriuta, Ski no Uta, Fuyugeshiki, Etenraku Imayo, Oboro Zukiyo, Furusato, Ware wa Umi no Ko; choral singing); instrumental music (ensemble, traditional Japanese instruments); music making; appreciation (orchestral instruments, traditional Japanese music, music of the countries of the world); elements that form music (sound of chords, key, meter, the vertical and horizontal relationships in music); music in C major and A minor; music and copyright

jhs3-japanese.label: Year 3
jhs3-japanese.title: Junior High Japanese, Year 3
jhs3-japanese.scope: Critical reading of logical texts, themes of literary texts, haiku, rhetorical devices, grammar review, idioms, proverbs, and classical-allusion idioms, native Japanese words, Sino-Japanese words, and loanwords, language change, classics (Man'yoshu, Kokin Wakashu, Shin Kokin Wakashu, Oku no Hosomichi, the Analects)

jhs3-science.label: Year 3
jhs3-science.title: Junior High Science, Year 3
jhs3-science.scope: Chemical changes and ions (electrolytes, acids, alkalis, and neutralization, batteries), motion and energy (composition and resolution of forces, laws of motion, work, conservation of energy), continuity of life (cell division, reproduction, heredity, evolution), Earth and space (daily and annual motion of celestial bodies, the solar system, how the Moon and Venus appear), nature and humans, science and technology and humans

jhs3-english.label: Year 3
jhs3-english.title: Junior High English, Year 3
jhs3-english.scope: Present perfect and present perfect continuous, participles as postpositive modifiers, relative pronouns, indirect questions, subjunctive mood, advanced infinitives (It is ... to, bare infinitive), reading longer passages, expressing opinions

jhs-music.label: Music
jhs-music.title: Junior High Music
jhs-music.scope: Music theory (notes and rests, time signatures, scales and keys, chords, symbols), singing (vocalization, Japanese songs), instrumental music (recorder, traditional Japanese instruments), composition, appreciation (Western music history: Baroque to modern and contemporary; traditional Japanese music: Gagaku, Noh, Kabuki, koto music; music of the world's peoples), music and copyright

jhs-art.label: Art
jhs-art.title: Junior High Art
jhs-art.scope: Shape and color (three attributes of color, color wheel, color schemes), sketching and drawing (perspective, shading), painting (watercolor, landscapes, figures, still life), sculpture, design (posters, lettering, pictograms, universal design), crafts, video and media expression, appreciation (Japanese art history, Western art history, contemporary art)

jhs-taiiku.label: Physical Education
jhs-taiiku.title: Junior High Health and Physical Education (Physical Education)
jhs-taiiku.scope: Physical conditioning exercises, gymnastics (mat, horizontal bar, balance beam, vault), track and field (sprints and relays, long-distance running, hurdles, long jump, high jump), swimming (front crawl, breaststroke, backstroke, butterfly), ball games (goal-type, net-type, base-running-type), martial arts (judo, kendo, sumo), dance (creative dance, folk dance, modern rhythm dance), physical education theory (diversity of exercise and sports, significance and effects of exercise and sports and how to learn and do them safely, significance of sports as culture)

jhs-hoken.label: Health
jhs-hoken.title: Junior High Health and Physical Education (Health)
jhs-hoken.scope: Healthy living and disease prevention (basis of health, lifestyle and health, lifestyle-related diseases, smoking, drinking, and drug abuse, infectious diseases, health and medical institutions and medicines), development of body and mind functions and mental health (physical growth and development, maturation of reproductive functions, development of mental functions and self-formation, coping with desires and stress), injury prevention (injuries from traffic accidents and natural disasters, first aid, CPR and AED), health and the environment (the body's adaptability, sanitary management of drinking water and air, disposal of household waste)

jhs-gijutsu.label: Technology
jhs-gijutsu.title: Junior High Technology and Home Economics (Technology)
jhs-gijutsu.scope: Technology of materials and processing (properties of wood, metal, and plastic, technical drawing, how tools and machines work and using them safely, planning production), technology of growing living things (growing crops, raising animals, cultivating aquatic organisms), technology of energy conversion (electric circuits and electrical safety, power generation and transmission, mechanisms that transmit motion, maintenance and inspection), information technology (how computers work, information security and information morals, programming interactive content using networks, programming for measurement and control), technology's relationship with society and the environment

jhs-katei.label: Home Economics
jhs-katei.title: Junior High Technology and Home Economics (Home Economics)
jhs-katei.scope: Family and home life (my growth and family and home life, young children's lives and family, relationships with family and local people, relating to older adults), food, clothing, and housing (role of meals and nutrition for junior high students, nutrients and food groups, menu planning, choosing and storing food, cooking everyday meals and local food culture, choosing and caring for clothes, sewing projects with fabric, functions of housing and living safely at home), consumer life and the environment (money management and purchasing, sales contracts and consumer harm, consumer rights and responsibilities, environmentally conscious consumer life)

jhs-dotoku.label: Moral Education
jhs-dotoku.title: Junior High Moral Education
jhs-dotoku.scope: The 22 content items of Moral Education as a special subject. A: Relating to oneself (independence, self-discipline, freedom and responsibility; moderation; aspiration and development of individuality; hope and courage, self-mastery and strong will; pursuit of truth and creativity). B: Relating to others (compassion and gratitude; courtesy; friendship and trust; mutual understanding and tolerance). C: Relating to groups and society (respect for rules and public morality; fairness, impartiality, and social justice; participation in society and public spirit; work; love of family and enriching family life; improving school life and group life; respect for local traditions and culture and love of one's hometown; respect for Japan's traditions and culture and love of one's country; international understanding and contribution). D: Relating to life, nature, and the sublime (the preciousness of life; care for nature; awe and wonder; the joy of living well).

es1-japanese.label: Grade 1
es1-japanese.title: Elementary Japanese, Grade 1
es1-japanese.scope: Hiragana and katakana, 80 Grade 1 kanji, subjects and predicates, speaking in order, writing about experiences, reading the gist of stories and explanatory texts, word play, folktales

es1-math.label: Grade 1
es1-math.title: Elementary Math, Grade 1
es1-math.scope: Numbers up to 10, number composition and decomposition, addition and subtraction (with carrying and borrowing), numbers greater than 20, comparing length, volume, and area, reading clocks, shapes

es12-zuko.label: Grades 1–2
es12-zuko.title: Elementary Arts and Crafts, Grades 1–2
es12-zuko.scope: Play with forms (becoming familiar with natural and man-made materials), drawing, 3D work, and crafts (expressing what you feel and imagine; how to use crayons, oil pastels, paints, clay, paper, scissors, and glue, and safety), appreciation (what is interesting about your own and your friends' works), noticing shapes and colors

es34-zuko.label: Grades 3–4
es34-zuko.title: Elementary Arts and Crafts, Grades 3–4
es34-zuko.scope: Play with forms (getting ideas from materials and places), drawing, 3D work, and crafts (how to use watercolors; wood scraps, boards, and nails; safe use of a knife, saw, and hammer; paper prints and woodblock prints), appreciation (familiar works and the process of making them), the feel of shapes and colors, the feel of combinations

es56-zuko.label: Grades 5–6
es56-zuko.title: Elementary Arts and Crafts, Grades 5–6
es56-zuko.scope: Play with forms (making use of the features of spaces and places), drawing, 3D work, and crafts (wire; safe use of a scroll saw; expressing depth and light and dark; beauty of composition; design that conveys a message), appreciation (familiar art works from Japan and other countries, forms in daily life), formative features of shapes and colors (movement, depth, balance, vividness of color)

es56-katei.label: Grades 5–6
es56-katei.title: Elementary Home Economics, Grades 5–6
es56-katei.scope: Family and home life (my growth and my family, household chores and time use, relationships with family and local people), life with clothing, food, and housing (role of meals, boiling and stir-fry cooking, rice and miso soup, the five major nutrients and the three food groups, planning one meal, wearing and caring for clothes, making items by hand sewing and sewing machine, living comfortably in each season, tidying up and cleaning), consumer life and environment (how shopping works and basics of purchase contracts, the value of goods and money and planned spending, environmentally conscious living), safe use of tools

es12-taiiku.label: Grades 1–2
es12-taiiku.title: Elementary Physical Education, Grades 1–2
es12-taiiku.scope: Physical conditioning play, play using apparatus and equipment (mat, horizontal bar, vaulting box, fixed facilities), running and jumping play, water play, games (ball games, tag games), expressive rhythm play, rules and safety in exercise (taking turns and following rules, checking the safety of the area and equipment)

es34-taiiku.label: Grades 3–4
es34-taiiku.title: Elementary Physical Education, Grades 3–4
es34-taiiku.scope: Physical conditioning exercises, apparatus gymnastics (basic skills in mat, horizontal bar, and vaulting box exercises), running and jumping (races and relays, low hurdles, long jump, high jump), swimming (floating and moving forward, submerging and floating), games (goal-type, net-type, baseball-type), expressive movement, health (healthy living: daily routines and the surrounding environment; growth and development of the body: body changes in puberty)

es56-taiiku.label: Grades 5–6
es56-taiiku.title: Elementary Physical Education, Grades 5–6
es56-taiiku.scope: Physical conditioning exercises, apparatus gymnastics, track and field (sprints and relays, hurdles, long jump, high jump), swimming (front crawl, breaststroke, exercises for ensuring safety), ball games (goal-type, net-type, baseball-type), expressive movement, health (mental health: development of the mind and coping with anxiety and worries; injury prevention: traffic accidents, everyday dangers, and first aid for injuries; disease prevention: infectious diseases, lifestyle-related diseases, smoking, drinking, drug abuse, and community health activities)

es34-gaikokugo.label: Grades 3–4
es34-gaikokugo.title: Elementary Foreign Language Activities, Grades 3–4
es34-gaikokugo.scope: Becoming familiar with the sounds and rhythms of English (greetings, feelings and conditions, numbers, colors and shapes, favorite things, uppercase and lowercase letters of the alphabet, days of the week, time, school supplies, things you want, favorite places, daily life), noticing differences in language and culture, listening and speaking (interaction, presentation)

es12-dotoku.label: Grades 1–2
es12-dotoku.title: Elementary Moral Education, Grades 1–2
es12-dotoku.scope: The 19 content items of Moral Education (Special Subject) for Grades 1–2. A: Relating to oneself (judging right from wrong, self-reliance, freedom and responsibility; honesty and sincerity; moderation and self-control; developing individuality; hope, courage, effort, and strong will), B: Relating to others (kindness and consideration, gratitude, courtesy, friendship and trust), C: Relating to groups and society (respect for rules; fairness, impartiality, and social justice; work and public spirit; family love and fulfilling family life; better school life and group life; respect for tradition and culture and love of country and hometown; international understanding and goodwill), D: Relating to life, nature, and the sublime (the preciousness of life, caring for nature, awe and wonder)

es34-dotoku.label: Grades 3–4
es34-dotoku.title: Elementary Moral Education, Grades 3–4
es34-dotoku.scope: The 20 content items of Moral Education (Special Subject) for Grades 3–4. A: Relating to oneself (judging right from wrong, self-reliance, freedom and responsibility; honesty and sincerity; moderation and self-control; developing individuality; hope, courage, effort, and strong will), B: Relating to others (kindness and consideration, gratitude, courtesy, friendship and trust, mutual understanding and tolerance), C: Relating to groups and society (respect for rules; fairness, impartiality, and social justice; work and public spirit; family love and fulfilling family life; better school life and group life; respect for tradition and culture and love of country and hometown; international understanding and goodwill), D: Relating to life, nature, and the sublime (the preciousness of life, caring for nature, awe and wonder)

es56-dotoku.label: Grades 5–6
es56-dotoku.title: Elementary Moral Education, Grades 5–6
es56-dotoku.scope: The 22 content items of Moral Education (Special Subject) for Grades 5–6. A: Relating to oneself (judging right from wrong, self-reliance, freedom and responsibility; honesty and sincerity; moderation and self-control; developing individuality; hope, courage, effort, and strong will; pursuit of truth), B: Relating to others (kindness and consideration, gratitude, courtesy, friendship and trust, mutual understanding and tolerance), C: Relating to groups and society (respect for rules; fairness, impartiality, and social justice; work and public spirit; family love and fulfilling family life; better school life and group life; respect for tradition and culture and love of country and hometown; international understanding and goodwill), D: Relating to life, nature, and the sublime (the preciousness of life, caring for nature, awe and wonder, the joy of living well)

hs-math1.label: Mathematics I
hs-math1.title: High School: Mathematics I
hs-math1.scope: Numbers and expressions (expansion and factorization, real numbers, linear inequalities, sets and propositions), quadratic functions (graphs, maximum and minimum, quadratic equations and inequalities), shapes and measurement (trigonometric ratios, law of sines and law of cosines, area), data analysis (variance and standard deviation, correlation, the idea of hypothesis testing)

hs-eicom3.label: English Communication III
hs-eicom3.title: High School English: English Communication III
hs-eicom3.scope: Mastering long-passage reading (paragraph structure, logical development, inference), English texts on highly abstract topics (science, society, culture, philosophy), fast reading and close reading, summarizing and expressing opinions, overall skills for university entrance exams

hs-ronhyo1.label: Logic and Expression I
hs-ronhyo1.title: High School English: Logic and Expression I
hs-ronhyo1.scope: English writing using basic sentence structures and sentence patterns, tenses, auxiliary verbs, the passive voice, verbals, relatives, comparisons, and the basics of the subjunctive mood; paragraph basics; speeches and interaction

hs-ronhyo2.label: Logic and Expression II
hs-ronhyo2.title: High School English: Logic and Expression II
hs-ronhyo2.scope: Logical paragraph writing (topic sentence, supporting sentences, conclusion), opinions and reasons, comparison and contrast, cause and effect, expressions for debates and discussions, techniques for translating Japanese into English

hs-ronhyo3.label: Logic and Expression III
hs-ronhyo3.title: High School English: Logic and Expression III
hs-ronhyo3.scope: Multi-paragraph essays, summaries and critiques, mastering free English composition and Japanese-to-English translation, presentations and debates, expressive skills for university entrance exams

hs-butsuri-kiso.label: Basic Physics
hs-butsuri-kiso.title: High School Science: Basic Physics
hs-butsuri-kiso.scope: Describing motion (velocity, acceleration, free fall), forces and the laws of motion, work and mechanical energy, heat and energy, waves (properties of waves, sound), electricity (current and resistance, electric power, alternating current and electromagnetic waves), energy and its uses

hs-butsuri.label: Physics
hs-butsuri.title: High School Science: Physics
hs-butsuri.scope: Mechanics (planar motion, rigid bodies, momentum, circular motion and simple harmonic motion, universal gravitation), thermodynamics (gas laws, kinetic theory of gases, first law of thermodynamics), waves (wave propagation, sound, light), electromagnetism (electric fields and potential, capacitors, DC circuits, magnetic fields, electromagnetic induction, alternating current), atoms (electrons and light, atoms and atomic nuclei)

hs-kagaku-kiso.label: Basic Chemistry
hs-kagaku-kiso.title: High School Science: Basic Chemistry
hs-kagaku-kiso.scope: Composition of matter (pure substances and mixtures, atomic structure, the periodic table, chemical bonding), amount of substance and chemical equations, acids and bases (pH, neutralization titration), oxidation-reduction reactions (oxidation numbers, batteries, basics of electrolysis)

hs-kagaku.label: Chemistry
hs-kagaku.title: High School Science: Chemistry
hs-kagaku.scope: States of matter (gases, solutions, solids), chemical reactions and energy (thermochemistry, batteries and electrolysis), reaction rates and chemical equilibrium, inorganic substances, organic compounds (aliphatic, aromatic), polymer compounds

hs-seibutsu-kiso.label: Basic Biology
hs-seibutsu-kiso.title: High School Science: Basic Biology
hs-seibutsu-kiso.scope: Characteristics of living things (cells, metabolism, enzymes, ATP), genes and their functions (DNA, replication, protein synthesis), regulation of the human body (body fluids, autonomic nerves and hormones, immunity), biodiversity and ecosystems (vegetation and succession, biomes, ecosystem conservation)

hs-seibutsu.label: Biology
hs-seibutsu.title: High School Science: Biology
hs-seibutsu.scope: Evolution of living things (origin of life, genetic variation, mechanisms of evolution, phylogeny), life phenomena and substances (cells and molecules, metabolism: respiration and photosynthesis), expression of genetic information and development (regulation of gene expression, development, biotechnology), responses of organisms to the environment (animal responses and behavior, plant responses to the environment), ecology and environment (populations, biological communities, ecosystems)

hs-chigaku-kiso.label: Basic Earth Science
hs-chigaku-kiso.title: High School Science: Basic Earth Science
hs-chigaku-kiso.scope: The Earth's features (shape and size, internal structure, plate tectonics, earthquakes and volcanoes), the changing Earth (strata and fossils, changes in ancient life), atmosphere and oceans (heat budget, motion of the atmosphere and seawater, weather in Japan), the universe (solar system, stars and galaxies, structure of the universe), Earth's environment and natural disasters

hs-chigaku.label: Earth Science
hs-chigaku.title: High School Science: Earth Science
hs-chigaku.scope: Overview of the Earth (gravity, geomagnetism, Earth's interior), Earth's activity (plate movement, earthquakes, igneous activity, metamorphism and orogeny), Earth's history (changes of the Earth's surface, geologic time, formation of the Japanese archipelago), atmosphere and oceans (structure and motion of the atmosphere, structure and motion of the oceans, climate change), structure of the universe (the Sun, stellar evolution, the Milky Way, cosmology)

hs-rekishi-sogo.label: Modern and Contemporary History
hs-rekishi-sogo.title: High School: Modern and Contemporary History
hs-rekishi-sogo.scope: Opening the door to history; Modernization and us (Industrial Revolution, civil revolutions, Meiji Restoration, imperialism); Changes in the international order, popularization of culture, and us (World War I, mass society, Great Depression, World War II); Globalization and us (Cold War, decolonization, economic growth, the post-Cold War world). Studying the modern and contemporary eras by connecting Japan and the world

hs-nihonshi.label: Japanese History Inquiry
hs-nihonshi.title: High School: Japanese History Inquiry
hs-nihonshi.scope: Prehistory and ancient times (Paleolithic to Heian); Medieval period (cloistered rule, Kamakura, Muromachi, Warring States); Early modern period (Oda-Toyotomi regimes, politics, economy, and culture of the Edo period); Modern and contemporary times (late Edo/Bakumatsu, Meiji, Taisho, prewar and postwar Showa, present day). Reading historical sources and connecting politics, economy, society, culture, and diplomacy

hs-sekaishi.label: World History Inquiry
hs-sekaishi.title: High School: World History Inquiry
hs-sekaishi.scope: Ancient civilizations and the formation of regional worlds (Orient, Mediterranean, South Asia, East Asia); Interaction and restructuring of regions (Islamic world, medieval Europe, Mongol Empire); Age of Discovery and the early modern world; Modern era (civil revolutions, Industrial Revolution, nation-states, imperialism); The two world wars; The Cold War and the contemporary world

hs-chiri-sogo.label: Comprehensive Geography
hs-chiri-sogo.title: High School: Comprehensive Geography
hs-chiri-sogo.scope: Maps and Geographic Information Systems (types of maps, time differences, GIS); International understanding and cooperation (diversity of lifestyles and cultures, global issues: environment, resources and energy, population, food, cities); Building sustainable communities (natural environment and disaster prevention, surveys of living areas)

hs-chiri-tankyu.label: Geography Inquiry
hs-chiri-tankyu.title: High School: Geography Inquiry
hs-chiri-tankyu.scope: Systematic geography (landforms, climate, agriculture, forestry and fisheries, resources and energy, industry, transportation and communication, population, villages and cities, lifestyles and cultures, ethnicity and religion); Regional geography (studying regions of the world); Inquiry into a vision of sustainable national land

hs-kokyo.label: Public
hs-kokyo.title: High School: Public
hs-kokyo.scope: Opening the door to the public (adolescence, ideas of great thinkers, basic principles of public spaces); Law and society (role of law, contracts, participation in the judicial system); Political participation (elections, local government, international politics); Economy and society (markets, finance, public finance, labor, social security); Building a sustainable society

hs-rinri.label: Ethics
hs-rinri.title: High School: Ethics
hs-rinri.scope: Challenges of adolescence; Foundational thought (Greek thought, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Chinese thought); Japanese thought (ancient to modern); Modern and contemporary Western thought (Renaissance, empiricism and rationalism, social contract theory, Kant, Hegel, utilitarianism, existentialism, contemporary thought); Contemporary issues and ethics (life, environment, information, welfare)

hs-seikei.label: Politics and Economics
hs-seikei.title: High School: Politics and Economics
hs-seikei.scope: Basic principles of democratic politics; the Constitution of Japan and fundamental human rights; Structure of government (Diet, Cabinet, courts); Local government; Elections and political parties; International politics (international law, United Nations, security); How the economy works (markets, national income, business cycles, finance, public finance); History of the Japanese economy; Labor and social security; International economy (trade, exchange rates, balance of payments, North-South problem, regional integration)

hs-joho1.label: Information I
hs-joho1.title: High School Information: Information I
hs-joho1.scope: Problem solving in the information society (information morals, intellectual property, personal information, security); Communication and information design (digital expression, binary numbers, compression, characteristics of media); Computers and programming (how they work, algorithms, programming, modeling and simulation); Information and communication networks and use of data (protocols, databases, statistics and data analysis)

hs-joho2.label: Information II
hs-joho2.title: High School Information: Information II
hs-joho2.scope: Advances in the information society and information technology; Communication and content; Information and data science (basics of machine learning, collecting, organizing, and analyzing data); Information systems and programming (design, development, evaluation); Project study

hs-katei.label: Basic Home Economics
hs-katei.title: High School: Basic Home Economics
hs-katei.scope: Human life span, family, and household (lifelong development, family and law); Child development and childcare; Old age and welfare; Eating habits (nutrition, food, cooking, food safety); Clothing; Housing; Consumer life and the environment (contracts, household budgeting, financial products, sustainable consumption); Life planning

hs-ongaku1.label: Music I
hs-ongaku1.title: High School: Music I
hs-ongaku1.scope: Advanced music theory (intervals, scales, harmony, musical forms); Expression in singing and instrumental music; Creation (melody writing, arranging); Appreciation (Western music history, Japanese traditional music, world music, popular music); The relationship between music and society and culture

hs-bijutsu1.label: Art I
hs-bijutsu1.title: High School Art: Art I
hs-bijutsu1.scope: Painting and sculpture (concept development, materials, expressive techniques), design (visual communication, product, environment), video media expression, appreciation (history of art in Japan and the world, ways of viewing works, art and society), theories of color and form

hs-kokugo-hyogen.label: Japanese Expression
hs-kokugo-hyogen.title: High School Japanese: Japanese Expression
hs-kokugo-hyogen.scope: Speaking and listening (speeches, presentations, discussions, interviews, honorifics and courteous expressions), writing (opinion essays, short essays, statements of purpose, letters and emails, reports, proposals, summaries, revision), expressive techniques (structure, presenting grounds for claims, vocabulary, style, effective expression), characteristics of language and choosing wording to suit the situation

hs-kagaku-ningen.label: Science and Human Life
hs-kagaku-ningen.title: High School Science: Science and Human Life
hs-kagaku-ningen.scope: Development of science and technology, science in human life (science of light and heat; science of matter: materials and their reuse, clothing and food; science of life: human life phenomena, microorganisms and their use; science of space and the Earth: the Sun and the Earth, natural landscapes and natural disasters), science and human life in the future

hs-taiiku.label: Physical Education
hs-taiiku.title: High School Physical Education: Physical Education
hs-taiiku.scope: Physical conditioning exercises, gymnastics, track and field, swimming, ball games (goal-type, net-type, baseball-type), martial arts, dance, theory of physical education (cultural characteristics of sports and the development of modern sports; effective ways to learn exercise and sports: skills and tactics, physical fitness training, safety; ways to design an enriching sports life)

hs-hoken.label: Health
hs-hoken.title: High School Health and Physical Education: Health
hs-hoken.scope: Modern society and health (concepts of health, modern infectious diseases and their prevention, prevention of and recovery from lifestyle-related diseases, smoking, drinking, drug abuse and health, prevention of and recovery from mental illness), safe social life (creating a safe society, first aid, cardiopulmonary resuscitation), health throughout life (adolescence, married life, aging and health; work and health), creating an environment that supports health (environment and health, food and health, health and medical systems and local health and medical institutions, various health activities and social measures, health-related environment building and social participation)

hs-ongaku2.label: Music II
hs-ongaku2.title: High School Art: Music II
hs-ongaku2.scope: Advancement of Music I. Advanced music theory and harmony (modulation, non-chord tones, analysis of musical forms), deeper expression (solo, vocal ensemble and choir, instrumental solo and ensemble, arrangement), composition (development of themes, composing with form in mind), appreciation (styles and historical background, genres and characteristics of traditional Japanese music, music of the world's peoples, contemporary music), music's relationship with other arts and society

hs-ongaku3.label: Music III
hs-ongaku3.title: High School Art: Music III
hs-ongaku3.scope: Advancement of Music II. Pursuit of individual expression (choosing and deepening singing, instrumental music, or composition), study of works (analysis of pieces, interpretation of performance), appreciation (critical writing, the flow of music history and aesthetic sense, diversity of musical culture), music in life and society (copyright, careers related to music)

hs-bijutsu2.label: Art II
hs-bijutsu2.title: High School Art: Art II
hs-bijutsu2.scope: Advancement of Art I. Painting and sculpture (generating themes, choosing forms of expression, techniques such as oil painting, printmaking, and modeling), design (concept development based on purpose and conditions, communication and usability), video media expression (photography, video, animation), appreciation (background of works and artists' intentions, characteristics of Japanese art, inheriting and creating art culture)

hs-bijutsu3.label: Art III
hs-bijutsu3.title: High School Art: Art III
hs-bijutsu3.scope: Advancement of Art II. Creative expression that draws on individuality (choosing and deepening painting and sculpture, design, or video media expression), planning and reflecting on production, appreciation (criticism, contemporary art, international understanding and art culture, roles of art museums and cultural properties)

hs-kogei1.label: Crafts I
hs-kogei1.title: High School Art: Crafts I
hs-kogei1.scope: Everyday life and crafts (function and beauty, characteristics of materials: wood, bamboo, metal, clay, dyeing and weaving, lacquer, paper, glass), production process (concept, drawings, tools and techniques, finishing, safety), society and crafts (design considering users and settings, traditional crafts and regions, product design), appreciation (traditional Japanese crafts, crafts of the world, Mingei [folk crafts], crafts in daily life)

hs-kogei2.label: Crafts II
hs-kogei2.title: High School Art: Crafts II
hs-kogei2.scope: Advancement of Crafts I. Exploring materials and techniques (woodworking joinery, metal hammering and casting, pottery forming and firing, dyeing and weaving, lacquer art), conceiving function and beauty, appreciation (history and styles of crafts, makers' ideas, tradition and the modern age)

hs-kogei3.label: Crafts III
hs-kogei3.title: High School Art: Crafts III
hs-kogei3.scope: Advancement of Crafts II. Production that draws on individuality (choosing and deepening a material), living environments and crafts, appreciation (criticism, inheriting and developing craft culture, international reach)

hs-shodo1.label: Calligraphy I
hs-shodo1.title: High School Art: Calligraphy I
hs-shodo1.scope: Calligraphy in Chinese characters (copying classics in regular and semi-cursive script: Jiuchenggong Liquan Ming, Confucius Temple Stele, Yanta Shengjiao Xu, Lanting Xu, etc.; brushwork and character forms; basics of cursive, clerical, and seal scripts), kana calligraphy (iroha, single characters and connected writing, classic works: Takano-gire, etc.), calligraphy mixing kanji and kana (calligraphy in daily life, expressive techniques), tools and materials (brush, ink, inkstone, paper), basics of seal carving and wood carving of characters, appreciation (history of calligraphy, changes in script styles, elements of beauty in calligraphy)

hs-shodo2.label: Calligraphy II
hs-shodo2.title: High School Art: Calligraphy II
hs-shodo2.scope: Advancement of Calligraphy I. Calligraphy in Chinese characters (copying classics of each script style and original creation), kana calligraphy (scattered writing, decorated paper, copying classic works and original creation), calligraphy mixing kanji and kana (expression suited to poetry and prose), appreciation (history of calligraphy in China and Japan, theories of calligraphy, features of famous works)

hs-shodo3.label: Calligraphy III
hs-shodo3.title: High School Art: Calligraphy III
hs-shodo3.scope: Advancement of Calligraphy II. Original creation that brings out individuality (choosing and deepening script styles and formats), composition of works and mounting, appreciation (critique, tradition and the present of calligraphy, calligraphy and other arts and daily life)

hs-katei-sogo.label: Comprehensive Home Economics
hs-katei-sogo.title: High School Home Economics: Comprehensive Home Economics
hs-katei-sogo.scope: The human life span, family, home, and welfare (lifelong development and life planning, independence in adolescence, family and home in society and law, children's lives, childcare and child-rearing support, elderly people's lives and basics of welfare and nursing care, an inclusive society, welfare and social security), the science and culture of food, clothing, and housing (eating habits: nutrition, food, cooking, food safety; clothing: clothing materials, clothing care, sewing; housing: functions of dwellings, living environment, community development; passing on and creating lifestyle culture), sustainable consumer life and environment (economic planning in daily life, consumer behavior and decision-making, contracts and consumer rights and responsibilities, sustainable lifestyles), home projects and school Home Economics Club activities

hs-risu-kiso.label: Fundamentals of Science and Mathematics Inquiry
hs-risu-kiso.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Fundamentals of Science and Mathematics Inquiry
hs-risu-kiso.scope: The significance and process of inquiry, research ethics, setting a topic (how to form questions, how to research prior studies), planning hypotheses and verification, basic skills of observation, experiment, and survey, handling data (measurement and error, basics of statistics, graphs), discussion and reasoning, writing reports and presenting

hs-risu-tankyu.label: Science and Mathematics Inquiry
hs-risu-tankyu.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Science and Mathematics Inquiry
hs-risu-tankyu.scope: Inquiry into a self-set topic (mathematical phenomena, natural phenomena, interdisciplinary areas), planning and carrying out inquiry, analyzing results (statistical processing, modeling), discussion and conclusions, writing papers and reports, presentations and Q&A, reflecting on the inquiry and new topics

hsp-nogyo-kankyo.label: Agriculture and the Environment
hsp-nogyo-kankyo.title: High School Agriculture: Agriculture and the Environment
hsp-nogyo-kankyo.scope: "Agriculture and the Environment" and project-based learning (characteristics of agricultural learning, methods and procedures of project-based learning), life and agriculture (food and agriculture, the natural environment and agriculture, environmental conservation and agriculture, lifestyle culture and agriculture, trends and prospects of agriculture), basics of agricultural production (types and characteristics of agricultural organisms, raising agricultural organisms and environmental factors, planning, process management, and evaluation of agricultural production, cultivation and rearing of agricultural organisms), projects on agriculture and the environment, school Agriculture Club activities

hsp-nogyo-kadai.label: Project Study
hsp-nogyo-kadai.title: High School Agriculture: Project Study
hsp-nogyo-kadai.scope: At school, this subject is done as practical training or project study. Since this app cannot provide the practical training itself, it covers what to know before you start, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Course of Study items: surveys, research, experiments, making works, practical training at industry sites, obtaining vocational qualifications, school Agriculture Club activities

hsp-nogyo-sogo-jisshu.label: Comprehensive Practical Training
hsp-nogyo-sogo-jisshu.title: High School Agriculture: Comprehensive Practical Training
hsp-nogyo-sogo-jisshu.scope: At school, this subject is done as practical training or project study. Since this app cannot provide the practical training itself, it covers what to know before you start, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Course of Study items: cultivation and rearing, basic training related to the environment, comprehensive training in each field of agriculture (comprehensive agricultural knowledge and skills, management and administration methods), comprehensive training at agricultural industry sites (comprehensive agricultural knowledge and skills, management and administration methods), school Agriculture Club activities

hsp-nogyo-joho.label: Agriculture and Information
hsp-nogyo-joho.title: High School Agriculture: Agriculture and Information
hsp-nogyo-joho.scope: Industrial society and information (significance of information in industrial society, roles and issues of information in agriculture, information morals and security management), information tools for agriculture (hardware and software, roles of information in each field of agriculture, information media and data), analysis and use of agricultural information (information and communication networks, systematization of production, processing, distribution, and management, analysis and use of agricultural information), agricultural learning and use of information

hsp-nogyo-sakumotsu.label: Field Crops
hsp-nogyo-sakumotsu.title: High School Agriculture: Field Crops
hsp-nogyo-sakumotsu.scope: "Field Crops" and project-based learning (significance of project-based learning on crop production and management, how to proceed with project-based learning), role and trends of crop production (role of crop production, life and the use of crops, crop distribution and supply-demand trends), characteristics and cultivation techniques of crops (types and features of crops, crop growth and physiology, cultivation environment and growth control, breeding and propagation), crop cultivation, management, and evaluation (characteristics of varieties and how to choose them, cropping types and cultivation plans, cultivation management, commercialization and management and evaluation of products, use of machinery and facilities), crop production and management (production goals and management plans, production process management, distribution and sales, crop production considerate of the local environment), practice in crop production and management

hsp-nogyo-yasai.label: Vegetables
hsp-nogyo-yasai.title: High School Agriculture: Vegetables
hsp-nogyo-yasai.scope: "Vegetables" and project-based learning (significance of project-based learning on vegetable production and management, how to proceed with project-based learning), role and trends of vegetable production (role of vegetable production, life and the use of vegetables, vegetable distribution and supply-demand trends), characteristics and cultivation techniques of vegetables (types and features of vegetables, vegetable growth and physiology, cultivation environment and growth control, breeding and propagation), vegetable cultivation, management, and evaluation (characteristics of varieties and how to choose them, cropping types and cultivation plans, cultivation management, commercialization and management and evaluation of products, use of machinery and facilities), vegetable production and management (production goals and management plans, production process management, distribution and sales, vegetable production considerate of the local environment), practice in vegetable production and management

hsp-kogyo-gijutsu-kiso.label: Fundamentals of Industrial Technology
hsp-kogyo-gijutsu-kiso.title: High School Industry: Fundamentals of Industrial Technology
hsp-kogyo-gijutsu-kiso.scope: People, technology, and the environment (people and technology, the mission and responsibility of engineers, the environment and technology), processing technology (processing that changes form, processing that changes quality), mechanisms of production (production processes, analysis and measurement technology)

hsp-kogyo-kadai.label: Project Study
hsp-kogyo-kadai.title: High School Industry: Project Study
hsp-kogyo-kadai.scope: At school, this course is carried out as practical training and project study. Since the practical training itself cannot be done in this app, it covers what to know before getting started, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Items in the Course of Study: creating works, product development, surveys, research, experiments, practical training at industrial sites, obtaining vocational qualifications

hsp-kogyo-jisshu.label: Practical Training
hsp-kogyo-jisshu.title: High School Industry: Practical Training
hsp-kogyo-jisshu.scope: At school, this course is carried out as practical training and project study. Since the practical training itself cannot be done in this app, it covers what to know before getting started, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Items in the Course of Study: elemental practical training, comprehensive practical training, practical training using advanced technology

hsp-kogyo-seizu.label: Technical Drawing
hsp-kogyo-seizu.title: High School Industry: Technical Drawing
hsp-kogyo-seizu.scope: The role of technical drawing (drawing and standards, how to represent drawings), technical drawing and design drawing for each field of industry, design drawing using information devices (CAD functions, 3D CAD)

hsp-kogyo-joho-suri.label: Industrial Information and Mathematics
hsp-kogyo-joho-suri.title: High School Industry: Industrial Information and Mathematics
hsp-kogyo-joho-suri.scope: Industrial society and information technology (progress of computerization and industrial society, information ethics, information security management), computer systems (hardware, software, information and communication networks), programming and mathematical processing of industrial phenomena (algorithms and programming, data input and output, mathematical processing, control programming)

hsp-kogyo-zairyo-gijutsu.label: Industrial Materials Technology
hsp-kogyo-zairyo-gijutsu.title: High School Industry: Industrial Materials Technology
hsp-kogyo-zairyo-gijutsu.scope: Social life and industrial materials, properties and structure of industrial materials (states of matter and material structure, deformation and flow, properties and structure), testing of industrial materials (testing of mechanical properties, microstructure examination with a microscope, testing with instruments), manufacture of industrial materials (manufacture of metal materials, ceramic materials, polymer materials, composite materials), processing of industrial materials (workability of industrial materials, main processing methods), industrial materials and the environment (industrial materials and environmental conservation, recycling of industrial materials)

hsp-kogyo-eigo.label: Technical English for Industry
hsp-kogyo-eigo.title: High School Industry: Technical English for Industry
hsp-kogyo-eigo.scope: Conversation related to industry, reading and writing related to industrial technology, presentations, communication using information and communication networks

hsp-kogyo-kanri-gijutsu.label: Industrial Management Technology
hsp-kogyo-kanri-gijutsu.title: High School Industry: Industrial Management Technology
hsp-kogyo-kanri-gijutsu.scope: Overview of industrial management technology, production planning and management (production planning, production management, production and distribution), process control and quality control (process control, quality control), safety management and environmental management (maintenance and upkeep, accidents at production sites and their prevention, environmental conservation), factory management (personnel management, industrial accounting, laws and regulations on factory management, industry and starting a business)

hsp-kogyo-kankyo-gijutsu.label: Environmental Technology for Industry
hsp-kogyo-kankyo-gijutsu.title: High School Industry: Environmental Technology for Industry
hsp-kogyo-kankyo-gijutsu.scope: Environment and humans, environment and industry (changes in environmental problems, environmental risk and safety, responses by industry), conservation of the living environment (urban environment, housing environment and health, disaster prevention and mitigation), environmental laws and regulations (laws on environmental conservation, environmental assessment), environmental countermeasure technology (air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, noise, vibration, odor, waste)

hsp-kogyo-kikai-kosaku.label: Machine Manufacturing
hsp-kogyo-kikai-kosaku.title: High School Industry: Machine Manufacturing
hsp-kogyo-kikai-kosaku.scope: Development of machine manufacturing methods, machine materials (workability and use of machine materials, workability and use of new materials), various manufacturing methods, measurement of industrial quantities and measuring instruments (measurement of industrial quantities, use of measuring instruments), production management (production planning and management, systematization of production through information technology)

hsp-kogyo-kikai-sekkei.label: Machine Design
hsp-kogyo-kikai-sekkei.title: High School Industry: Machine Design
hsp-kogyo-kikai-sekkei.scope: The role of design in production, forces acting on machines (forces and motion acting on machines, relationship among energy, work, and power), strength of materials (relationship between stress and strain in machine parts, shapes of machine parts), machine elements and devices (fastening elements, shaft elements, transmission devices, shock-absorbing devices, piping, structures, pressure vessels), design of tools and machines (tool design, machine design)

hsp-kogyo-gendoki.label: Prime Movers
hsp-kogyo-gendoki.title: High School Industry: Prime Movers
hsp-kogyo-gendoki.scope: Energy conversion and the environment (power and energy, energy and prime movers, energy and the environment), fluid machinery (properties and mechanics of fluids, water turbines and pumps, blowers and compressors, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment), internal combustion engines (thermodynamics, principles of internal combustion engines, gasoline engines, diesel engines, internal combustion engines and automobiles), turbine engines (steam turbines, gas turbines), refrigeration equipment

hsp-kogyo-kagaku-kogaku.label: Chemical Engineering

hsp-kogyo-chikyu-kankyo-kagaku.label: Global Environmental Chemistry
hsp-kogyo-chikyu-kankyo-kagaku.title: High School Industry: Global Environmental Chemistry

hsp-kogyo-zairyo-kogaku.label: Materials Engineering

hsp-kogyo-zairyo-kako.label: Materials Processing

hsp-kogyo-ceramic-kagaku.label: Ceramic Chemistry
hsp-kogyo-ceramic-kagaku.title: High School Industry: Ceramic Chemistry

hsp-kogyo-ceramic-gijutsu.label: Ceramic Technology

hsp-kogyo-ceramic-kogyo.label: Ceramic Industry
hsp-kogyo-ceramic-kogyo.title: High School Industry: Ceramic Industry

hsp-kogyo-seni-seihin.label: Textile Products

hsp-kogyo-seni-senshoku.label: Textile and Dyeing Technology

hsp-kogyo-interior-sobi.label: Interior Fittings

hsp-kogyo-design-jissen.label: Design Practice

hsp-kogyo-design-zairyo.label: Design Materials
hsp-kogyo-design-zairyo.title: High School Industry: Design Materials
hsp-kogyo-design-zairyo.scope: Design and materials (daily life and materials, types and characteristics of materials, use of materials in design), properties and processing technology of inorganic materials (metal materials, ceramic materials, glass), properties and processing technology of organic materials (plastics, wood), materials and processing technology that expand the possibilities of design

hsp-kogyo-design-shi.label: History of Design
hsp-kogyo-design-shi.title: High School Industry: History of Design
hsp-kogyo-design-shi.scope: Japanese design (life and form in ancient times, life and form in the medieval period, life and form in the early modern period, life and design in the modern period), Western design (life and form in ancient times, life and form in the medieval period, life and form in the early modern period, establishment and development of modern design), contemporary design

hsp-shogyo-business-kiso.label: Business Basics
hsp-shogyo-business-kiso.title: High School Commerce: Business Basics
hsp-shogyo-business-kiso.scope: Learning commerce and business (importance and methods of learning commerce, role of business, trends and issues in business), attitude toward business (building trust, basics of communication, obtaining and using information), economy and distribution (basic concepts of economics, role of distribution, activities supporting distribution), transactions and business calculations (sales transactions and payment settlement, methods of business calculation), corporate activities (forms and organization of companies, importance and flow of marketing, fundraising, role of financial statements, taxes on corporate activities, employment), business in the local community (issues in the local community, business trends in the local community)

hsp-shogyo-sogo-jissen.title: High School Commerce: Comprehensive Practice

hsp-shogyo-communication.label: Business Communication
hsp-shogyo-communication.title: High School Commerce: Business Communication
hsp-shogyo-communication.scope: Business and communication (decision-making and behavior as a member of an organization, building human networks); business manners (manners for dealing with people, social manners, customer service manners); thinking and communication in business (verbal and nonverbal communication, ways of thinking in business, communication in business); business and foreign languages (globalization of corporate activities, culture and business customs, business conversation, business documents and e-mail, presentations in business)

hsp-shogyo-marketing.label: Marketing
hsp-shogyo-marketing.title: High School Commerce: Marketing
hsp-shogyo-marketing.scope: The modern market and marketing (changes in the market environment, development of marketing, the marketing process, consumer behavior); market research (purposes and methods of market research, analysis of information); product policy (overview of product policy, product planning and production planning, sales planning and sales forecasting, trends in product policy); price policy (overview of price policy, types of prices and how they are set, trends in price policy); channel policy (overview of channel policy, types and features of channels, trends in channel policy); promotion policy (overview of promotion policy, promotion methods, trends in promotion policy)

hsp-shogyo-shohin.label: Product Development and Distribution
hsp-shogyo-shohin.title: High School Commerce: Product Development and Distribution
hsp-shogyo-shohin.scope: The modern market, product development and distribution (the concept of a product and the product development process, how distribution works and its relation to products, changes in the market environment); product planning (environmental analysis, deciding development policy and theme, market research, creating a product plan); business planning (detailed design and evaluation of product specifications, creating product design, registering intellectual property, setting prices, creating a business plan, trends and issues in product development); distribution and promotion (developing distribution channels, carrying out promotion, trends and issues in distribution and promotion)

hsp-shogyo-kanko.label: Tourism Business
hsp-shogyo-kanko.title: High School Commerce: Tourism Business

hsp-shogyo-management.label: Business Management
hsp-shogyo-management.title: High School Commerce: Business Management

hsp-shogyo-global.label: Global Economy

hsp-shogyo-hoki.label: Business Law

hsp-shogyo-boki.label: Bookkeeping
hsp-shogyo-boki.title: High School Commerce: Bookkeeping

hsp-shogyo-zaimu1.label: Financial Accounting I
hsp-shogyo-zaimu1.title: High School Commerce: Financial Accounting I

hsp-shogyo-genka.label: Cost Accounting
hsp-shogyo-genka.title: High School Commerce: Cost Accounting
hsp-shogyo-genka.scope: Costs and cost accounting (the concept of cost, features and mechanism of cost accounting), cost calculation by expense item (calculating material costs, labor costs, and expenses), cost calculation by department and by product (job-order costing and calculating manufacturing overhead, departmental job-order costing, process costing), internal accounting (completion and sale of products, independence of factory accounting, closing of accounts in manufacturing), standard costing (purpose and procedures of standard costing, analysis of cost variances by cause), direct costing (purpose of direct costing and preparing financial statements, use in short-term profit planning)

hsp-shogyo-kanri-kaikei.title: High School Commerce: Management Accounting

hsp-shogyo-net-katsuyo.title: High School Commerce: Network Utilization

hsp-suisan-marine-sports.scope: Use of the sea and environmental conservation (effective use of the sea, conservation of the natural environment), fishing (sea fishing, river fishing), recreational diving (snorkeling, skin diving, scuba diving), marine recreation (rules at sea and natural phenomena, sailing, canoeing and kayaking, other marine sports), safety instruction and safety management (safety instruction, safety management)

hsp-katei-sangyo-kiso.label: Basics of Lifestyle Industries
hsp-katei-sangyo-kiso.title: High School Home Economics: Basics of Lifestyle Industries

hsp-katei-shohi.label: Consumer Life
hsp-katei-shohi.title: High School Home Economics: Consumer Life

hsp-katei-hoiku-kiso.label: Basics of Childcare
hsp-katei-hoiku-kiso.title: High School Home Economics: Basics of Childcare

hsp-suisan-gyogyo.label: Fishing
hsp-suisan-gyogyo.title: High School Fisheries: Fishing
hsp-suisan-gyogyo.scope: Fishing and the marine environment (role and history of fishing; overview of Japan's fishing industry and fishing vessels; marine environment and ocean ecosystems; fishing grounds and ground surveys; conservation of the marine environment), fishery resources and fishery management (ecology of aquatic organisms; fishery resources; fishery management), fishing technology (fishing gear and methods; major fisheries and resource enhancement; composition and materials of fishing gear; fishing machinery; measuring instruments; refrigeration machinery), foundations of fishery production (fishery systems and laws; international environment surrounding fishing; fishing and information; trade and distribution; quality control and safety management), fishery management and business (structure of fishery businesses; business organization, management, and operation; improving efficiency of fishery businesses)

hsp-suisan-kokai.label: Navigation and Instruments

hsp-suisan-senpaku-unyo.label: Ship Operation

hsp-suisan-kikan.label: Marine Engines
hsp-suisan-kikan.title: High School Fisheries: Marine Engines

hsp-suisan-idotai-tsushin.label: Mobile Communications Engineering
hsp-suisan-idotai-tsushin.title: High School Fisheries: Mobile Communications Engineering

hsp-suisan-kaiyo-tsushin.label: Marine Communication Technology
hsp-suisan-kaiyo-tsushin.title: High School Fisheries: Marine Communication Technology

hsp-suisan-zoshoku.label: Resource Enhancement
