hsp-kango-kiso.label: Fundamentals of Nursing
hsp-kango-kiso.title: High School Nursing: Fundamentals of Nursing
hsp-kango-kiso.scope: The essence of nursing (significance of nursing, roles and functions of nursing, recipients of nursing, collaborating professionals, ethics in nursing), common nursing skills (communication, infection prevention, safety management, physical assessment, nursing process), assistance with daily living (understanding daily life, environmental adjustment, meals and nutrition, elimination, activity and exercise, rest and sleep, cleanliness and clothing), assistance accompanying medical care (respiration, circulation, and body temperature regulation; medication administration; wound management; examinations, tests, and treatments; lifesaving emergency care; end-of-life care)

hsp-kango-jintai.label: Structure and Function of the Human Body
hsp-kango-jintai.title: High School Nursing: Structure and Function of the Human Body
hsp-kango-jintai.scope: Anatomy and physiology (composition of the human body, structure and function of organ systems, homeostasis, biological defense mechanisms), nutrition (functions of nutrients, nutrients and metabolism, diet and health, life stages and nutrition, pathological conditions and nutrition)

hsp-kango-shippei.label: Causes of Disease and Promotion of Recovery
hsp-kango-shippei.title: High School Nursing: Causes of Disease and Promotion of Recovery
hsp-kango-shippei.scope: Causes of disease and recovery of the body (disease prevention and early detection, causes of disease, recovery of the body), basic causes of disease (circulatory disorders, inflammation, metabolic disorders, heredity and congenital anomalies, immune disorders, tumors, infection), diagnosis and treatment of disease (diagnostic process, diseases and clinical tests, main treatments), functional disorders (respiratory; circulatory; nutrient intake, digestion, absorption, and metabolism; internal environment regulation; hematopoietic; immune; nervous; motor; excretory; reproductive; mental), disease and drugs (drug actions, drugs and the body's reactions, drug therapy, health damage caused by drugs)

hsp-kango-shakai-hosho.label: Health Support and the Social Security System
hsp-kango-shakai-hosho.title: High School Nursing: Health Support and the Social Security System
hsp-kango-shakai-hosho.scope: Public health (basics of public health, living environment and health, health promotion for residents, infectious diseases and countermeasures, health activities), social security system (basics of the social security system, health-related systems, medical care systems, welfare systems)

hsp-kango-seijin.label: Adult Nursing
hsp-kango-seijin.title: High School Nursing: Adult Nursing
hsp-kango-seijin.scope: Adult health and nursing (characteristics of each stage of adulthood, adult health and welfare, characteristics of adult nursing, ethical issues in adult nursing), nursing according to health level and disability (acute phase, chronic phase, terminal phase, rehabilitation nursing, cancer nursing), nursing for patients with functional disorders (respiratory, circulatory, digestive and absorptive, nutritional and metabolic, internal environment regulation, endocrine, body defense, brain and nervous, sensory, motor, urinary, sexual/reproductive/mammary gland dysfunction)

hsp-kango-ronen.label: Gerontological Nursing
hsp-kango-ronen.title: High School Nursing: Gerontological Nursing
hsp-kango-ronen.scope: Characteristics of older adults and nursing (life and health of older adults, health and welfare of older adults, characteristics of gerontological nursing, ethical issues in gerontological nursing), nursing that supports older adults' lives (assessment of older adults, communication, meals and nutrition, elimination, cleanliness, walking and mobility, sleep, activity and sense of purpose), nursing for older adults receiving medical care (acute phase, chronic phase, terminal phase), health disorders common in older adults and nursing (infectious diseases, fractures, parkinsonism, dementia, depression, delirium)

hsp-kango-shoni.label: Pediatric Nursing
hsp-kango-shoni.title: High School Nursing: Pediatric Nursing
hsp-kango-shoni.scope: Child health and nursing (characteristics of child health, child health and welfare, characteristics of pediatric nursing, ethical issues in pediatric nursing), health issues and nursing at each stage of childhood (neonatal and infant period, early childhood, school age, adolescence), nursing for children receiving medical care (nursing accompanying medical care, acute phase, chronic phase, terminal phase)

hsp-kango-bosei.label: Maternal Nursing
hsp-kango-bosei.title: High School Nursing: Maternal Nursing
hsp-kango-bosei.scope: Maternal health and nursing (concept of motherhood, trends in maternal and child health, reproductive health/rights, characteristics of maternal nursing, ethical issues in maternal nursing), health issues and nursing at each stage of the female life cycle (adolescence, maturity, menopause, old age), perinatal nursing (normal perinatal course and nursing, perinatal abnormalities and nursing)

hsp-kango-seishin.label: Psychiatric Nursing
hsp-kango-seishin.title: High School Nursing: Psychiatric Nursing
hsp-kango-seishin.scope: Mental health and nursing (mental health, structure and development of mental functions, stress and crisis, trends in mental health, characteristics of psychiatric nursing), history of mental health, medical care, and welfare (history of psychiatric care, advocacy for the rights of people with mental disorders, history of mental health and welfare systems), nursing according to the condition of mental disorders (tests, treatment, acute phase, chronic phase), major mental disorders and nursing (organic mental disorders including symptomatic ones, mental and behavioral disorders due to psychoactive substances, schizophrenia, mood disorders, neurotic disorders, stress-related disorders, physiological disorders, behavioral syndromes associated with physical factors, adult personality and behavioral disorders, mental and psychosomatic disorders of childhood and adolescence)

hsp-kango-zaitaku.label: Home Care Nursing
hsp-kango-zaitaku.title: High School Nursing: Home Care Nursing
hsp-kango-zaitaku.scope: Characteristics of home care nursing (significance of home care nursing, roles and functions of home care nursing, recipients of home care nursing, ethical issues in home care nursing), systems that support home care (community-based integrated care system, home-visit nursing system, medical insurance system, long-term care insurance system), support for home care patients and their families (assistance with daily care, assistance accompanying treatment, assistance according to the patient's situation)

hsp-joho-contents.label: Content Production and Distribution
hsp-joho-contents.title: High School Information: Content Production and Distribution
hsp-joho-contents.scope: Information society and content (roles and effects of content, types and characteristics of media, protection of content); still image content (expression with still images, editing still images, producing still image content); video content (expression with video, editing video, producing video content); sound and audio content (expression with sound and audio, editing sound and audio, producing sound and audio content); content distribution (methods of distributing content, integrating and editing content, distributing and evaluating content)

hsp-joho-media.label: Media and Services
hsp-joho-media.title: High School Information: Media and Services
hsp-joho-media.scope: Media and the information society (functions of media, use of media); services using media (functions of media-based services, use of media-based services); roles and effects of media-based services (relationship between media-based services and the information society, relationship between media-based services and the information industry)

hsp-joho-jisshu.label: Information Practicum
hsp-joho-jisshu.title: High School Information: Information Practicum
hsp-joho-jisshu.scope: A course done at school as practical training or project study. Since the practical work itself can't be done in this app, it covers what to know before starting, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Course of Study topics: the process of developing information systems (overview of information system development, design of information systems, development and evaluation of information systems, operation and maintenance of information systems); the process of producing content (overview of content production, requirements analysis and planning, design and production of content, operation and evaluation of content); practicum (information system development practicum, content production practicum, integrated practicum linking the information systems and content fields)

hsp-fukushi-kiso.label: Fundamentals of Social Welfare
hsp-fukushi-kiso.title: High School Welfare: Fundamentals of Social Welfare
hsp-fukushi-kiso.scope: Principles and significance of social welfare (daily life and welfare, principles of social welfare, human dignity and independence); human relationships and communication (building human relationships, basics of communication, overview of social welfare support activities); history of social welfare thought and prospects for a welfare society (social welfare in other countries, social welfare in Japan, development of community welfare); social security systems that support daily life (significance and role of social security systems, public assistance for livelihood support, child and family welfare and social welfare services, welfare for the elderly and the long-term care insurance system, welfare for people with disabilities and the comprehensive support system for persons with disabilities, systems related to care practice)

hsp-fukushi-kaigo-kiso.label: Fundamentals of Care Work
hsp-fukushi-kaigo-kiso.title: High School Welfare: Fundamentals of Care Work
hsp-fukushi-kaigo-kiso.scope: Significance and role of care (care that supports dignity, support toward independence); those who provide care work (circumstances surrounding care, roles of care workers and certified care workers, ethics of care workers, collaboration in care practice); understanding and caring for people who need care (people who need care and their living environments, life and care of the elderly, life and care of people with disabilities, overview of care welfare services); ensuring safety and risk management in care (safety and accident prevention in care, health management of care workers, infection control, welfare equipment and care robots)

hsp-fukushi-communication.label: Communication Skills
hsp-fukushi-communication.title: High School Welfare: Communication Skills
hsp-fukushi-communication.scope: Communication in welfare practice (significance and role of communication, basic communication skills); communication with service users and their families (communication suited to the service user, building relationships with service users and their families); team communication in welfare practice (sharing information through records, collaboration as a team)

hsp-fukushi-seikatsu-shien.label: Daily Living Support Skills
hsp-fukushi-seikatsu-shien.title: High School Welfare: Daily Living Support Skills
hsp-fukushi-seikatsu-shien.scope: Understanding daily living support (understanding daily life, concepts of daily living support, roles of and cooperation with other professions); daily living support toward independence (basics of care skills, improving the living environment, support with personal grooming and dressing, support with mobility, support with meals, support with bathing and keeping clean, support with toileting, support with housework, support with sleep and rest, support with recreation); support in emergencies and disasters; end-of-life support; medical care (understanding medical care, suctioning of sputum for the elderly and people with disabilities, tube feeding for the elderly and people with disabilities)

hsp-fukushi-kaigo-katei.label: Care Process
hsp-fukushi-kaigo-katei.title: High School Welfare: Care Process
hsp-fukushi-kaigo-katei.scope: Significance and role of the care process; development of the care process (information gathering and assessment, living challenges and goal setting, drafting a care plan, carrying out and evaluating the care plan); practical development of the care process; team approach in the care process (significance of the care process and the team approach, the care process and the team approach in practice)

hsp-fukushi-enshu.label: Integrated Care Seminar
hsp-fukushi-enshu.title: High School Welfare: Integrated Care Seminar
hsp-fukushi-enshu.scope: A course done at school as practical training or project study. Since the practical work itself can't be done in this app, it covers what to know before starting, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Course of Study topics: care exercises, case studies, surveys, research, experiments

hsp-fukushi-jisshu.label: Care Practicum
hsp-fukushi-jisshu.title: High School Welfare: Care Practicum
hsp-fukushi-jisshu.scope: A course done at school as practical training or project study. Since the practical work itself can't be done in this app, it covers what to know before starting, how to proceed, how to keep records and reflect, and safety and ethics. Course of Study topics: practicum in diverse care settings (practicing communication, practicing care skills, understanding multidisciplinary collaboration and team care); continuous practicum for understanding individualized care (practicing individualized care skills, practicing the care process)

hsp-fukushi-kokoro-karada.label: Understanding the Mind and Body
hsp-fukushi-kokoro-karada.title: High School Welfare: Understanding the Mind and Body
hsp-fukushi-kokoro-karada.scope: Basic understanding of the mind and body (understanding the mind, understanding how the body works); understanding the mind and body needed for daily living support (mind and body related to grooming and dressing, to mobility, to meals, to bathing and cleanliness, to toileting, to sleep and rest, to emergencies and disasters, and to end-of-life); understanding development and aging (human growth and development, understanding old age and daily life, the elderly and health); understanding dementia (basic understanding of dementia, physical and mental changes and daily life with dementia, circumstances surrounding dementia); understanding disabilities (basic understanding of disabilities, understanding impairments of daily functioning, understanding the lives of people with disabilities)

hsp-fukushi-joho.label: Welfare Information
hsp-fukushi-joho.title: High School Welfare: Welfare Information
hsp-fukushi-joho.scope: The information society and welfare services (the information society, use of information devices and welfare services); information ethics and security (information ethics, information security management); information devices and information and communication networks (how information devices work and programming, how information and communication networks work); welfare services and the use of information devices (collecting, organizing, analyzing, and sharing information, use of information devices in each field of welfare services, supporting independent living of the elderly and people with disabilities using information devices, management of personal information)

hsp-eigo-sogo1.label: Integrated English I
hsp-eigo-sogo1.title: High School English: Integrated English I
hsp-eigo-sogo1.scope: Develops all five areas together: listening, reading, speaking (interaction and presentation), and writing. On everyday and social topics, listen to or read coherent English passages to grasp the main points and intentions, organize information and ideas, and share them by speaking and writing. Vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and text structure are treated at a more advanced level than in English Communication I

hsp-eigo-sogo2.label: Integrated English II
hsp-eigo-sogo2.title: High School English: Integrated English II
hsp-eigo-sogo2.scope: A continuation of Integrated English I. On social topics, read and listen to multiple English texts and materials to pick up the necessary information and grasp the overview, main points, details, and the writer's intentions. Share information and ideas in detail by speaking and writing, with attention to the organization and development of logic. Summarizing, opinions and supporting reasons, and expressions for explanation, description, and comparison

hsp-eigo-sogo3.label: Integrated English III
hsp-eigo-sogo3.title: High School English: Integrated English III
hsp-eigo-sogo3.scope: A continuation of Integrated English II. On a wide range of social topics, read and listen to long argumentative texts, critical essays, and news reports, and compare multiple materials to consider issues from many angles. Communicate by speaking and writing, with attention to the organization and development of logic so as to persuade listeners and readers. Vocabulary for abstract content, complex sentence structures, and use of different styles

hsp-eigo-debate1.label: Debate and Discussion I
hsp-eigo-debate1.title: High School English: Debate and Discussion I
hsp-eigo-debate1.scope: Basics of discussion and debate in English. Stating opinions and reasons, expressing agreement and disagreement, questions and answers, confirming and summarizing what others say, conducting a discussion and roles, debate formats (constructive speech, cross-examination, rebuttal, summary), analyzing the topic, presenting evidence, commonly used expressions

hsp-eigo-debate2.label: Debate and Discussion II
hsp-eigo-debate2.title: High School English: Debate and Discussion II
hsp-eigo-debate2.scope: A continuation of Debate and Discussion I. Argumentation on social topics (claim, evidence, warrant), constructing arguments using multiple materials, rebuttal and re-rebuttal, organizing and comparing points at issue, the judge's perspective, discussion aimed at reaching consensus, expressions for speaking impromptu

hsp-eigo-essay1.label: Essay Writing I
hsp-eigo-essay1.title: High School English: Essay Writing I
hsp-eigo-essay1.scope: Basics of English paragraphs and essays. Topic sentences, supporting sentences, concluding sentences, transition words, presenting opinions, reasons, and examples, writing explanation, comparison, cause and effect, and opinion texts, how to draft and revise, the difference between quotation and plagiarism

hsp-eigo-essay2.label: Essay Writing II
hsp-eigo-essay2.title: High School English: Essay Writing II
hsp-eigo-essay2.scope: A continuation of Essay Writing I. Multi-paragraph argumentative essays (introduction, body, conclusion, thesis statement), responding to opposing opinions, summarizing and quoting sources, tone and style, structure with the reader in mind, revising and proofreading

hsp-risu-sugaku1.label: Science and Mathematics: Mathematics I
hsp-risu-sugaku1.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Mathematics I
hsp-risu-sugaku1.scope: Numbers and expressions, figures and measurement, quadratic functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, data analysis, counting and probability. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-risu-sugaku2.label: Science and Mathematics: Mathematics II
hsp-risu-sugaku2.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Mathematics II
hsp-risu-sugaku2.scope: Various expressions, sequences, trigonometric functions and the complex plane, figures and equations, limits, differential calculus, integral calculus, statistical inference. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-risu-sugaku-tokuron.label: Advanced Topics in Science and Mathematics: Mathematics
hsp-risu-sugaku-tokuron.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Advanced Topics in Mathematics
hsp-risu-sugaku-tokuron.scope: Vectors, matrices and their applications, discrete graphs, the relationship between mathematics and daily life and society. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-risu-butsuri.label: Science and Mathematics: Physics
hsp-risu-butsuri.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Physics
hsp-risu-butsuri.scope: Force and motion, waves, electricity and magnetism, atoms. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-risu-kagaku.label: Science and Mathematics: Chemistry
hsp-risu-kagaku.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Chemistry
hsp-risu-kagaku.scope: Chemistry and human life, the composition of matter, changes in matter and their uses, states of matter and chemical equilibrium, properties of inorganic substances, properties of organic compounds, the role of chemistry. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-risu-seibutsu.label: Science and Mathematics: Biology
hsp-risu-seibutsu.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Biology
hsp-risu-seibutsu.scope: Characteristics and evolution of living things, life phenomena and substances, expression of genetic information and development, responses of organisms to the environment, ecology and the environment. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-risu-chigaku.label: Science and Mathematics: Earth Science
hsp-risu-chigaku.title: High School Science and Mathematics: Earth Science
hsp-risu-chigaku.scope: Overview and structure of the Earth, activity of the Earth, history of the Earth, structure and motion of the atmosphere and oceans, structure and evolution of the universe, the relationship between the natural environment and human life. As a course in the Science and Mathematics program, it covers the content of the common mathematics and science courses at a more advanced level, including definitions, proofs, derivations, and the process of inquiry

hsp-taiiku-gairon.label: Introduction to Sports
hsp-taiiku-gairon.title: High School Physical Education: Introduction to Sports
hsp-taiiku-gairon.scope: Cultural characteristics of sports and the development of sports today (history and culture of sports, international competitions, ties to the economy and media, sports ethics and doping prevention); effective ways of learning sports (techniques and tactics, the process of skill improvement, practice planning, principles of physical conditioning, mental preparation); ways of designing a rich sports life (life stages and sports, ways of being involved: playing, watching, supporting, and learning, policies and environments that promote sports); diverse coaching methods and health and safety in sports (coaching suited to developmental stage, coaching free of violence and harassment, preventing injuries and heatstroke, approaches to emergency care); planning and managing sports (planning competitions and events, organization, publicity, safety management, review)

hsp-taiiku-sports1.label: Sports I
hsp-taiiku-sports1.title: High School Physical Education: Sports I
hsp-taiiku-sports1.scope: Diverse ways of being involved in scored sports (gymnastics) and measured sports (track and field, swimming; skiing, skating, etc. in some regions). Since practical activity cannot be done in this app, it covers the origins and characteristics of the sports, events and rules, scoring and measurement systems, principles of techniques and movements (mechanics and body use), practice stages and planning, injury prevention and safety, and ways of being involved such as judging, record-keeping, management, coaching, and spectating

hsp-taiiku-sports2.label: Sports II
hsp-taiiku-sports2.title: High School Physical Education: Sports II
hsp-taiiku-sports2.scope: Diverse ways of being involved in ball games. Goal-type (basketball, handball, soccer, rugby), net-type (volleyball, table tennis, tennis, badminton), baseball-type (softball, baseball), target-type (golf). Since practical activity cannot be done in this app, it covers the characteristics of each type, rules and officiating, ideas about individual skills and team tactics, game analysis, practice planning, injury prevention and safety, and ways of being involved such as judging, record-keeping, management, coaching, and spectating

hsp-taiiku-sports3.label: Sports III
hsp-taiiku-sports3.title: High School Physical Education: Sports III
hsp-taiiku-sports3.scope: Diverse ways of being involved in budo (judo, kendo, sumo, karate-do, naginata, kyudo, aikido, Shorinji Kempo, jukendo) and combat sports of other countries (wrestling). Since practical activity cannot be done in this app, it covers the origins and traditional thinking of budo, etiquette, characteristics and rules of each event, principles of techniques (off-balancing, distancing, body movement, etc.), practice stages, safety thinking to prevent head and neck injuries, and ways of being involved such as judging, management, coaching, and spectating

hsp-taiiku-sports4.label: Sports IV
hsp-taiiku-sports4.title: High School Physical Education: Sports IV
hsp-taiiku-sports4.scope: Diverse ways of being involved in dance. Creative dance (creative dance, contemporary rhythm dance) and traditional dance (folk dance, social dance). Since practical activity cannot be done in this app, it covers the history and culture of dance, characteristics of each type, ideas about movement, rhythm, space, and composition, how to create and present works, appreciation and critique, injury prevention, and ways of being involved such as planning and managing performances and coaching

hsp-bijutsu-shi.label: History of Art
hsp-bijutsu-shi.title: High School Art: History of Art
hsp-bijutsu-shi.scope: Japanese art and culture (from the Jomon, Yayoi, and Kofun periods through the Asuka, Nara, and Heian periods, the Kamakura and Muromachi periods, the Momoyama and Edo periods, to the modern era); Eastern art and culture (China, the Korean Peninsula, India, Islam, etc.); Western art and culture (antiquity, the Middle Ages, the Renaissance, Baroque and Rococo, the modern era); contemporary art and culture (trends since the 20th century, relationships with media and society). Covers connections with the society and thought of each era, characteristics of styles, major artists and works, and exchange between regions

hsp-bijutsu-kansho-kenkyu.label: Appreciation Study
hsp-bijutsu-kansho-kenkyu.title: High School Art: Appreciation Study
hsp-bijutsu-kansho-kenkyu.scope: Study of works and artists (how to view and analyze works, how to research artists and their historical backgrounds); study of the preservation and restoration of cultural properties (types of cultural properties and protection systems, causes of deterioration, approaches to preservation and restoration); study of exhibition planning and organization (roles of art museums and museums, planning exhibitions, organizing and explaining displays); art criticism (how to write criticism with supporting evidence)

hsp-bijutsu-sobyo.label: Drawing
hsp-bijutsu-sobyo.title: High School Art: Drawing
hsp-bijutsu-sobyo.scope: Dessin (drawing studies), sketching, expressive materials, and appreciation. Since this app cannot teach drawing practice, it covers ways of seeing things (form, proportion, structure, light and shade, texture, space, perspective), the aims and procedures of dessin and sketching, the characteristics of materials and tools such as pencil, charcoal, conté, and pen, ways of capturing the human body, still life, and landscapes, common stumbling points and how to fix them, and appreciation of excellent drawings

hsp-bijutsu-kosei.label: Composition
hsp-bijutsu-kosei.title: High School Art: Composition
hsp-bijutsu-kosei.scope: Form, color, materials, two-dimensional composition, three-dimensional composition, and appreciation. Covers elements of form (point, line, plane, solid), principles of composition (balance, rhythm, proportion, contrast, unity and variation), color systems (hue, value, saturation, color-order systems, color schemes, how colors appear and their psychology), the properties and expressiveness of materials, approaches and procedures for two- and three-dimensional composition, and appreciation of excellent compositions and designs

hsp-bijutsu-kaiga.label: Painting
hsp-bijutsu-kaiga.title: High School Art: Painting
hsp-bijutsu-kaiga.scope: Japanese-style painting (Nihonga), watercolor, oil painting, manga, illustration, other types of painting, and appreciation. Since this app cannot teach drawing practice, it covers the characteristics of each form of expression, the workings and handling of materials and tools such as paints and supports, main techniques, finding and planning themes, approaches to composition and color, how to proceed with creating a work, precautions for handling solvents and pigments safely, and appreciation of paintings

hsp-bijutsu-hanga.label: Printmaking
hsp-bijutsu-hanga.title: High School Art: Printmaking
hsp-bijutsu-hanga.scope: Woodblock prints, copperplate prints (etching and engraving), lithography, silkscreen, other prints, and appreciation. Since this app cannot teach production, it covers the characteristics of prints (multiplicity, indirectness), the differences among relief, intaglio, planographic, and stencil printing systems, an overview of the materials, tools, and processes for each, printing and plate management (editions), the dangers of processes using blades and chemicals and how to prevent them, and the history and appreciation of prints

hsp-bijutsu-chokoku.label: Sculpture
hsp-bijutsu-chokoku.title: High School Art: Sculpture
hsp-bijutsu-chokoku.scope: Carving, modeling, other sculpture and three-dimensional art, and appreciation. Since this app cannot teach production, it covers the characteristics of sculpture (mass, movement, balance, space), an overview of the materials, tools, and processes of carving (wood, stone) and modeling (clay, plaster, armature, mold making), three-dimensional work in diverse materials such as metal and resin, the dangers of blades, power tools, and dust and how to prevent them, and appreciation of sculptures

hsp-bijutsu-visual-design.label: Visual Design
hsp-bijutsu-visual-design.title: High School Art: Visual Design
hsp-bijutsu-visual-design.scope: Fundamentals of visual design (purposes and conditions, ideation, lettering and typefaces, layout, color, figures and photographs); design according to communication purpose (posters, marks and logos, pictograms, editorial design, packaging, advertising); spatial design (signage planning, exhibitions, displays); drafting methods; methods of representation (projection drawings, perspective drawings, charts and diagrams); and appreciation. Also touches on copyright and trademarks

hsp-bijutsu-craft-design.label: Craft Design
hsp-bijutsu-craft-design.title: High School Art: Craft Design
hsp-bijutsu-craft-design.scope: Fundamentals of craft design (users and purposes, function and beauty, materials and processing, from ideation to prototype); drafting methods; technical drawing (projection drawings, dimensions, sketches, models); crafts (overview of materials and techniques in ceramics, textiles and dyeing, lacquerware, metalwork, woodwork, glass, etc.); product design (design of everyday goods and devices, ergonomics, universal design, relationship with production); traditional crafts (traditional craft products and techniques of various regions, and their transmission); and appreciation. Also touches on the dangers of processes using blades, machines, kilns, and chemicals and how to prevent them

hsp-bijutsu-media-design.label: Information Media Design
hsp-bijutsu-media-design.title: High School Art: Information Media Design
hsp-bijutsu-media-design.scope: Fundamentals of information media (types and characteristics of media, how digital images, sound, and video work, color and resolution, intellectual property rights); visualization of information (diagrams, infographics, maps, icons, ways of presenting data); communication, exchange, and sharing (screen design for websites and apps, interaction, usability, accessibility, posting on social media); and appreciation

hsp-bijutsu-eizo.label: Video and Image Expression
hsp-bijutsu-eizo.title: High School Art: Video and Image Expression
hsp-bijutsu-eizo.scope: Knowledge of equipment, tools, and materials and skills for using them (how cameras and lenses work, exposure, lighting, audio, principles of photography and animation); planning, composition, and direction (proposals, scenarios, storyboards, composition and camera work, connecting shots); editing, compositing, and processing (approaches to editing, color adjustment, compositing, sound editing, exporting); and appreciation. Also touches on portrait rights and copyright in filming and publishing, and safety during filming

hsp-bijutsu-kankyo-zokei.label: Environmental Design
hsp-bijutsu-kankyo-zokei.title: High School Art: Environmental Design
hsp-bijutsu-kankyo-zokei.scope: Living environments and design (public spaces, landscapes, public art, gardens and plazas); exhibition planning and design (planning exhibition spaces, traffic flow, lighting, models); stage production and design (stage art, large and small props, lighting, costumes); other environmental design (installations, community-based art projects); and appreciation. Also touches on the dangers of installing large structures and working at heights and how to prevent them

hsp-taiiku-sports5.label: Sports V
hsp-taiiku-sports5.title: High School Physical Education: Sports V
hsp-taiiku-sports5.scope: Diverse ways of engaging with outdoor activities: nature-experience type (camping, mountain climbing, long-distance swimming and other water activities) and competitive type (skiing, skating). Because practical activities cannot be done in this app, it covers ways of engaging such as the significance and characteristics of outdoor activities, understanding the natural environment and weather, how to make plans, equipment, basic approaches for each activity, dangers such as getting lost, drowning, hypothermia and heatstroke and how to prevent them, conservation of the natural environment, and instruction and management

hsp-taiiku-sports6.label: Sports VI
hsp-taiiku-sports6.title: High School Physical Education: Sports VI
hsp-taiiku-sports6.scope: Diverse ways of engaging with physical fitness exercises, how to exercise to deepen awareness of body and mind and interaction according to purpose, and how to plan exercises and calisthenics suited to life stages and lifestyles. It covers ways of engaging such as body structure and elements of physical fitness, principles and methods of training, the concept of body-conditioning (taiho-gushi) exercises, exercise plans suited to age, purpose and lifestyle, exercise with nutrition and rest, preventing injuries from overexertion, and instruction and support

hsp-taiiku-enshu.label: Comprehensive Sports Seminar
hsp-taiiku-enshu.title: High School Physical Education: Comprehensive Sports Seminar
hsp-taiiku-enshu.scope: Project study on diverse theories and practices of sports, project study on diverse instruction, planning and management of sports, and project study on diverse social participation through sports. At school, this is a course done as project study. In this app, it covers how to find a topic, how to research and make a plan, how to collect and analyze data, how to summarize and present, and research ethics

hsp-ongaku-riron.label: Music Theory
hsp-ongaku-riron.title: High School Music: Music Theory
hsp-ongaku-riron.scope: Music rudiments (pitch names and solfège names, staves, notes and rests, time signatures and rhythm, intervals, scales and keys, transposition and modulation, chords, musical terms and symbols); musical forms (motifs and phrases, binary and ternary form, rondo form, variations, sonata form, fugue, etc.); harmony (triads and seventh chords, chord functions, rules of chord progression, cadences, inversions, non-chord tones, borrowed chords and modulation); counterpoint (independence of melodies, basics of two-part counterpoint, imitation and canon). As needed, it also touches on the theory of Japan's traditional music (scales, meter, forms)

hsp-ongaku-shi.label: Music History
hsp-ongaku-shi.title: High School Music: Music History
hsp-ongaku-shi.scope: The history of Japanese music (ancient music and gagaku, shomyo, noh, koto music, shamisen music and shakuhachi music, early modern theater music, the reception of Western music since the Meiji era, contemporary music) and the history of music in other countries (centered on Western music history: ancient and medieval, Renaissance, Baroque, Classical, Romantic, modern and contemporary; also touching on the history of music in other regions). It covers the relationship with the society and culture of each period, characteristics of styles, and major composers and works, and connects the two

hsp-ongaku-enso-kenkyu.label: Performance Study
hsp-ongaku-enso-kenkyu.title: High School Music: Performance Study
hsp-ongaku-enso-kenkyu.scope: Study of interpretation and performance based on expressive characteristics of periods and regions, study of interpretation and performance based on the expressive characteristics of composers, study of interpretation and performance based on the characteristics of voices and instruments, and the diversity of musical interpretation. Because performance itself cannot be done in this app, it covers how to read scores, period styles and performance practices (ornamentation, tempo, articulation, dynamics), the idiom of each composer, differences between editions, perspectives for comparing performances of the same piece, and how to explain interpretations in words

hsp-ongaku-solfege.label: Solfège
hsp-ongaku-solfege.title: High School Music: Solfège
hsp-ongaku-solfege.scope: Sight-singing, sight-playing, and ear training (dictation). Because sounds cannot be produced and checked in this app, it covers foundational knowledge for score-reading ability (clefs, how to hear intervals and clues for singing them, how to read and count rhythms, time signatures, keys and solfège names, distinguishing chords), how to proceed with practice in sight-singing, sight-playing and dictation, and how to proceed when writing down music on a score and common stumbling points

hsp-ongaku-seigaku.label: Vocal Music
hsp-ongaku-seigaku.title: High School Music: Vocal Music
hsp-ongaku-seigaku.scope: Solo singing and various forms of ensemble. Because singing instruction cannot be given in this app, it covers how the voice is produced (breathing, phonation, resonance), voice types and vocal ranges, concepts of posture and breathing, pronunciation of words (basics of singing pronunciation in Japanese, Italian, German, etc.), genres such as art songs, opera and choral music and representative works, interpretation of pieces, how to blend in duets and choruses, and how to practice in ways that protect vocal health. As needed, it also touches on Japan's traditional singing

hsp-ongaku-kigaku.label: Instrumental Music
hsp-ongaku-kigaku.title: High School Music: Instrumental Music
hsp-ongaku-kigaku.scope: Solo performance on keyboard, string, wind, percussion and Japanese traditional instruments, and various forms of ensemble. Because performance instruction cannot be given in this app, it covers the classification of instruments and how they produce sound, the structure, range and tone of each instrument, basic concepts of playing techniques, representative works, practice planning and how to practice without hurting the body, ensemble formats and how to play together in chamber music, wind band, orchestra, etc., and instrument care

hsp-ongaku-sakkyoku.label: Composition
hsp-ongaku-sakkyoku.title: High School Music: Composition
hsp-ongaku-sakkyoku.scope: Creating pieces in various forms of expression. It covers how to create motifs and melodies, adding chords to a melody, building forms, accompaniment patterns, writing that makes use of the range and characteristics of voices and instruments (introductory orchestration), arranging, creating music that makes use of the characteristics of Japan's traditional music, how to notate music, creating music with computers, and the basics of copyright

hsp-ongaku-kansho-kenkyu.label: Music Appreciation Study
hsp-ongaku-kansho-kenkyu.title: High School Music: Music Appreciation Study
hsp-ongaku-kansho-kenkyu.scope: Study of works and composers, study of regional and cultural backgrounds, the relationship between music and media, and music criticism. It covers perspectives for analyzing works while listening, how to research a composer's life and style, the music and cultural backgrounds of the world's peoples, the relationship between music and media such as recording, broadcasting and streaming, and how to write critical reviews with supporting evidence

hsp-bijutsu-gairon.label: Introduction to Art
hsp-bijutsu-gairon.title: High School Art: Introduction to Art
hsp-bijutsu-gairon.scope: Basic theories of art (the significance and fields of art, elements and principles of design, color theory, form and space, an overview of materials and techniques), nature and art, art in daily life and society (the role of design and crafts, art museums and cultural properties, jobs related to art), and intellectual property rights and portrait rights (basics of copyright, quotation, portrait rights, points to be careful about in creating and presenting works)
